findings.title: Top nav 'Docs' link lacks active state indicator on /docs
findings.observation: When on /docs or /docs/*, none of the header nav items (including 'Docs') carry data-active="true" or aria-current. Home correctly marks active on /. Docs layout uses fumadocs + shared hub nav but active detection is not wired for docs subtree.
findings.impact: Breaks hub nav parity: user on docs does not see the current section highlighted in top chrome, inconsistent with Home/Reader surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Extend nav active logic (or fumadocs link props) to set data-active when pathname starts with '/docs'. Ensure 'Docs' is active for all doc subroutes.

findings.title: Docs sidebar too wide on mobile (331px on 390px viewport) crowding content
findings.observation: On 390x844 viewport, the docs sidebar (fumadocs aside) measures ~331.5px wide and remains visible or only partially overlays. Link count 13+ creates dense vertical list. Main content area is squeezed or pushed.
findings.impact: Mobile docs reading is impaired: insufficient space for prose, possible overlap, high tap density in sidebar. Poor mobile sidebar UX.
findings.recommendation: Configure fumadocs DocsLayout to use mobile drawer/overlay (sidebarOpen or collapsible). Hide sidebar by default on <768px and provide hamburger that slides in full or 80% width panel. Add responsive width rules.

findings.title: ⌘K / search toggle visible on docs (parity good)
findings.observation: Search⌘K affordance is rendered in header via fumadocs SearchToggle on both desktop and mobile. Text 'Search⌘K' appears. Command palette (global ⌘K) also reachable from docs.
findings.impact: Positive: consistent quick-access search entrypoint across hub and docs.
findings.recommendation: No action; monitor that palette results include doc pages via /api/docs/search.

findings.title: Docs index content is thin; mostly links and headings, long vertical whitespace
findings.observation: The /docs landing renders a prose intro plus many anchor links and sections but limited visual cards or depth before the sidebar TOC. 'On this page' and main links feel list-heavy.
findings.impact: First impression of docs is sparse compared to hub surfaces. May not guide users strongly.
findings.recommendation: Add a quick-start card grid (Reader / Sources / Dashboard / CLI) or featured guide teasers at top of index.

findings.title: Dark theme on docs applies correctly (fumadocs + custom vars)
findings.observation: Switching to dark class updates colors without breakage; text, cards, sidebar legible. Consistent with other audited surfaces.
findings.recommendation: Continue verifying code blocks and fumadocs elements in dark.

findings.title: Mobile header + sidebar affordance density on narrow docs pages
findings.observation: At 390px the top 'AI Web Feeds Open web AI reader' branding + Search + nav links + docs title take space; combined with persistent wide sidebar creates vertical scrolling before content.
findings.impact: Slight friction on very small screens for docs consumption.
findings.recommendation: Tighten mobile header (smaller logo/title) or collapse top branding on scroll/doc pages.

passed_checks: dark theme renders without contrast loss on docs
CLI doc page content complete and scrollable
shared top nav present on docs (hub parity base)
